candidate_responsibility: Align product leadership, sponsors, pilot teams, adoption paths, and measurable organizational value for AI work.

dimensions.question: What responsibility the source contributes to this cluster.
Methods, phases, tools, or templates contributed by the source.
Inputs consumed and artifacts or decisions produced.
Rules, gates, evidence checks, and validation criteria.
Tools, mutation authority, external effects, and consent boundaries.
Known limitations, failure modes, and unsupported assumptions.

fusion_rules.rule: Align product leadership, sponsors, pilot teams, adoption paths, and measurable organizational value for AI work.
Accept only: An AI initiative, organizational constraints, leadership questions, pilot candidates, and value hypotheses.
Produce only: An adoption plan, leadership decision material, pilot evidence, and ownership model.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: An AI initiative, organizational constraints, leadership questions, pilot candidates, and value hypotheses.
output_boundary: An adoption plan, leadership decision material, pilot evidence, and ownership model.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 组织先允许团队广泛实验，再自上而下收敛高信念方向、集中人才，并持续审计功能是否解决核心目标。; 争取 AI 项目领导投入时组合内部相邻成功案例、contingency/rollback 与 maximum downside，并把研究想法连接到可货币化路径。; 企业 AI 采用同时需要高层支持、技术邻近的内部 evangelists/tiger team、可观察价值试点和 bottom-up adoption；来源建议从 repeatable business process 证明价值。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 用于组织层 AI 集成；发散阶段与聚焦投入阶段不同，不能只实验而不收敛。; 用于领导投资决策材料；历史 proof point 和 willingness-to-pay 示例不能代替当前项目证据。; 用于组织采用而非单一功能设计；即时 ROI 是需验证的价值证据，不是预设承诺。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 5 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (gate=2, method=3); each is bound to an exact source citation.
